jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej 3D Platform Engineer,**

**Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?**


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

 **Your new job**


You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.


We’re looking for a 3D Platform Engineer to build the shared capabilities behind IKEA’s next generation of 3D digital planning and product experiences. You will transform complex CAD and PLM product data into reliable, scalable 3D assets and services—covering tessellation, mesh optimization, LOD generation, and preservation of visual and geometric fidelity. Your work will make high\-quality 3D product data easier to use across customer\-facing planning solutions, content production, and product development. On a typical week, you will:

* Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle\-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C\#, C\+\+, and Python.
* Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well\-defined development briefs.
* Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product\-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
* Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
* Build automated CAD\-to\-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
* Develop and validate mesh\-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high\-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
* Benchmark and integrate commercial and open\-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud\-based 3D processing services.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**


As a 3D Platform Engineer, you combine strong software engineering with practical knowledge of 3D data, pipelines, and runtime needs. You can work across the full flow—from CAD and PLM sources to optimized assets and scalable services. You should also bring:

* A strong understanding of computer graphics, real\-time and offline rendering, and production\-ready 3D asset pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
* Knowledge of product\-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
* Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
* A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business\-critical services in an agile environment.
* A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong C\+\+ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third\-party libraries.
* Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
* Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.


Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C\+\+, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh\-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all\- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.


It’s a plus if you also bring:

* Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
* Experience with mesh\-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!**


Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.


Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co\-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

 **We welcome your application**


Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 15th of October.


This is a full\-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager taco.van.der.maden1@inter.ikea.com.


At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.


If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co\-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co\-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer (AI Transformation) – Agentic Engineering

£800 per day OUTSIDE IR35

Initial 8 week ‘Discovery’ engagement

Remote

Agentic Workflows | Software Architecture | C#.Net | Azure | Python | React

Principal Software Engineer -
We’re working with a leading UK technology business that is embarking on a major AI-driven engineering transformation. The business is challenging the traditional approach to software delivery and asking a fundamental question: can a world-class engineer working alongside AI agents deliver the output, speed and quality of a much larger engineering team?

They are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join an initial 8 week production pilot to assess what agentic engineering can achieve in a real-world environment.
This is not an AI research role. It is an opportunity for an exceptional software engineer who has already embraced AI tooling in their workflow, understands how to use agents effectively, and can demonstrate how this changes the way complex engineering problems are solved.

The Role

You’ll work alongside an existing Tech Lead to drive the modernisation of a core customer-facing application. The ambition is to completely rebuild the platform onto a modern multi-platform architecture, while avoiding the traditional approach of a long, high-risk rewrite. The approach is incremental: establish the foundations, deliver customer value early, and progressively replace the existing application.

You’ll bring the engineering judgment, architectural thinking and AI fluency needed to understand where agents can accelerate delivery, where human expertise is essential, and how to create a new model for software development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead an AI-native approach to rebuilding a major customer application.
Define the target architecture and technical direction.
Build production-quality software using AI agents and modern workflows.
Identify where agentic tooling can materially improve delivery speed.
Help embed new engineering practices across the team.

What They’re Looking For

Principal or Lead-level software engineering experience.
Strong architecture and modern software engineering fundamentals.
Proven experience using AI agents/tooling to accelerate complex engineering work.
Experience leading technical change, migrations or platform transformations.
Ability to operate in ambiguity and create direction.
Strong product mindset and focus on customer outcomes.

You don’t need to claim to have “mastered” agentic engineering. The field is evolving rapidly. What matters is that you have the engineering depth to understand complex systems, the curiosity to experiment, and real examples of how AI tooling has changed your approach to building software.

Why This Role?

This is a rare opportunity to help define what the next generation of software engineering looks like. You’ll be given significant autonomy, working on a highly visible transformation where success is measured by tangible outcomes: faster delivery, lower engineering effort, maintained quality and a new operating model for building software with AI.

For an engineer who believes AI will fundamentally change how software is created, this is an opportunity to prove it at production scale.

Please reply with your CV or call Simon for a chat.

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
As Caysure Digital continues to grow, we are looking to recruit a Senior Developer to help improve, maintain and continually develop our products.
The ideal candidate will have a broad technical skillset and experience building and maintaining large-scale business applications. You will be involved in designing, developing and testing new features, supporting our existing applications and helping shape our technical approach.
Our technology stack includes Microsoft Azure, Java and Spring Boot, Lucee 7, Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript, Cypress and Docker. We also use services including Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory and Azure AI Foundry.

What you will do Support and develop our existing applications through bug fixes, improvements and new features
Design and develop new functionality based on client and business requirements
Help ensure product features are delivered to the required level of quality
Proactively participate in the full Scrum development lifecycle
Develop and maintain REST APIs and third-party integrations
Contribute to our Java and Spring Boot REST API
Develop and support Azure Functions and other Azure services
Work closely with QA to improve our Cypress automated test coverage
Conduct regular peer code reviews
Support and mentor other members of the development team
Identify and raise technical issues or suggested improvements
Help maintain the quality of our products throughout the development lifecycle

What you will have At least five years’ commercial software development experience
Experience with Lucee or CFML
Java and Spring Boot experience
Experience building and maintaining object-oriented web applications
Strong Microsoft SQL Server experience
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs
Good JavaScript, HTML and CSS knowledge
Experience using Git and Bitbucket
Experience working with Microsoft Azure
Experience working with Docker and containerised applications
A good understanding of secure, maintainable software development
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
The ability to work independently as part of a remote team

What you may have Experience with ColdBox, TestBox or MockBox
Cypress or other test automation experience
Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory or Azure AI Foundry
Leadership or mentoring experience
CI/CD experience
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular
Experience working within insurance, claims or document management
